khalliKhalesOfferCreate.descriptionPlaceholder: What will happen? For whom? Does it need prior experience?
khalliKhalesOfferCreate.descriptionHint: The first two lines appear on the card in the gift shop.
khalliKhalesOfferCreate.categoryHint: One word describing the type — it shows as a tag on the card.
khalliKhalesOfferCreate.activityHoursHint: Total hours the providers will deliver the activity.
khalliKhalesOfferCreate.resourceHint: — and the cash deposit, if any, is not subject to tax.
guideItems: Human service = service hours × hourly rate (from 1 to 5 Shahamham).
Organization services to the public (workshops, courses, programs) = (providers' hours × hourly rate) ÷ number of seats.
The provider sets the hourly rate between 1 and 5 — these bounds protect the network from exaggeration in both directions.
You can publish for free — it's recorded at zero value and isn't deducted from your cap.
